purpose: Find/test native AMD-compatible H3 text encoder and compare speed/RAM/VRAM/quality to corrected NVFP4 eager baseline. No production promotion.

protocol.objective: Find/test native AMD-compatible H3 text encoder and compare speed/RAM/VRAM/quality to corrected NVFP4 eager baseline. No production promotion.
protocol.hardware: dual7900XTX/gfx1100; each encoder process sees physicalcard0 only

prompts.prompt: A cinematic close-up of a red ceramic teapot on a pale wooden table. A delicate white ribbon of steam slowly rises from its spout, curling in warm morning sunlight. A green plant softly out of focus in the background. The camera is locked off. Audio: gentle birdsong outside and a soft quiet room ambience. No speech, text, logos or music.

A bright yellow toy bus drives slowly from left to right across a dark blue tabletop. Three small red wooden blocks stand beside the bus. The camera stays fixed. Audio: a quiet toy motor and soft rolling wheels. No speech, captions, logos or music.

A macro shot of a bumblebee sitting on a violet flower in a sunlit garden. The bee slowly moves its wings. Blurred green foliage fills the background. The camera is fixed. Audio: a gentle bee buzz and light outdoor ambience. No speech, text, logos or music.

protocol.load_trials: one excluded full-process warmup +three measured fresh-process loads/arm; counterbalanced order; file-specific POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED beforetimedload, actualread_bytes measured; no globalcacheflush
protocol.timing: synchronize GPU before/after load and encode; tokenize timed separately; serialize/hash outside encode timing; dispatch trace warmup only; no per-module diagnostic hooks
protocol.quality: same saved prompt-specific finite conditioning -> actualfcysTP2+CK608x352x39/20steps/res_multistep/simple/seed42; compare sampledframes1/20/39 and AVdecode; audio semantics unqualified
protocol.discovery: Native Comfy textencoder defaultfull_precision_mm=True: W4A8HIPdequant works. Test built-in comfy.ops.use_quantized_matmul opt-in separately, without modifyingweights/modelmathsource; quantifyactivationINT8qualitytradeoff.
protocol.integer_arm: Experimental existing quantized-matmul context plus per-call opt-out of forced casting on eligible quantized linears only, restored afterwards. FP32 intermediates/norms and all independent safety guards preserved. Qualify accuracy separately.
protocol.file_cache_policy: Read-only file-specific advisory under exclusive guardedGPUownership, beforetimer; no globalcache/sysctlchanges. Report actualreadbytes andexceptions.

recommendation.summary: W4A8 with verified native HIP INT8 matrix multiplication is a viable AMD candidate for the 7900 XTX on the tested workload. It substantially reduces encoding time, with similar owned RAM and slightly lower peak Torch-reserved VRAM than corrected NVFP4. The paired clips retain the requested main scenes, while composition changes and shared negative-instruction failures remain. The gain applies to encoding; loading remains large and variable.
recommendation.decision: Recommend the native-HIP W4A8 option as the tested candidate for this short, text-only staged workload. Loading W4A8 through the default ComfyUI text-encoder path keeps floating-point multiplication and delivers essentially the same encode time as NVFP4. The faster result requires the explicitly tested per-call integer option; it is not a filename-only speedup. Production selection remains unchanged.
recommendation.limits: This sample does not establish perceptual non-inferiority, BF16 accuracy, long-prompt behaviour, image-conditioned use, long-range motion or audio prompt compliance. Teapot steam does not clearly originate at the requested spout, and all bus variants contain unwanted side markings. No matched full-workflow timing series or production promotion is claimed.
recommendation.short: Native W4A8 preserves the sampled main scenes, with design changes and shared prompt limitations; it remains an isolated tested candidate.

quality_scope: Visual assessment of frames 1, 20 and 39 in each 39-frame, 1.625-second clip, using the same denoiser and seed. This is a small, non-blind sample; no BF16 accuracy oracle, long-motion, image-conditioning or perceptual-audio qualification.
